title: Juicy Nostalgic Slovakian Apples Salad
description: This Paleo-friendly and vegan Juicy Nostalgic Slovakian Apples Salad features fermented apples with a touch of vanilla extract for a unique twist on the traditional dish, ideal as a snack or light meal.
instructions: Mix the fermented apples with a small amount of coconut oil and vanilla extract until well combined.
If using, add a pinch of aloe vera gel to help bind the mixture together for a thicker consistency.
Fold in chia seeds to enhance texture and nutrition. Adjust quantities based on personal preference and desired texture.
Serve immediately or store in an airtight container at room temperature.
